name: invariant-normative-leaf-view
description: Renders a com.semanticops.spec/invariant record as a normative document leaf for the specification (srs-spec.md): invariant_number keeps its label as the citation identifier, and normative_statement reads directly under its heading with no label (labelMode: none). The rationale field is omitted: the reasons behind a constraint belong to the unified and rationale documents, not to the normative spec (srs#982). The unified composition keeps invariant-leaf-view (c20c6fff), which shows the rationale.
